Intro.tagline: WHERE THE BLUE SKY MEETS THE AZURE SEA
Intro.description: Meili Resort is nestled on a golden sandy beach in the heart of the lagoon, enjoying one of the world's most iconic ocean views. Spacious overwater bungalow suites and beachfront villas create a unique luxury experience for guests, perfectly blending natural beauty with refined service.
